identity.name: dsh-thermal-receipt
identity.description: Print an ESC/POS 58mm thermal receipt on every DSH turn end (works in dsh-tui and dsh-desktop via the core session/event seam)

permissions.reason: Spawn the bundled Python bridge (vendor/thermal_bridge.py) to send raw ESC/POS bytes to the local thermal printer via Win32 spooler

_notes.evidence: Parsed-level: manifest follows the v0.15 community-consensus field names (facets.host / requires.contracts / permissions / subscriptions). Not admitted against a real dsh-TUI Host; treat as experimental until negotiated. The DSH-core compatibility surface (dsh.bundle.patch + cordis.patch.yml) is the load-bearing contract - it works with the official `dsh plugin add` today.
_notes.no-provides: v0.15 rejects `provides`/`services` facets; this plugin only subscribes and spawns - it provides no Cordis services.
